query: Читай CSV-файлы из директории /data/input/orders/, оставляй только строки где поле status равно COMPLETED, пиши результат в /data/output/completed_orders.csv.

runs.yaml_pim:
flow:
  id: filter_completed_orders
  name: Filter Completed Orders from CSV
  description: Read CSV files from /data/input/orders/, filter rows where status=COMPLETED,
    output to /data/output/completed_orders.csv
triggers:
- id: trigger_schedule
  type: schedule
  condition: every 5 minutes
sources:
- id: source_csv
  name: Read CSV Files
  type: CSV
  location: /data/input/orders/
  connection:
    properties:
      path: /data/input/orders/
      file_pattern: '*.csv'
      format: csv
processing_elements:
- id: filter_completed
  name: Filter COMPLETED
  operation: Filter
  config:
    condition: status == 'COMPLETED'
sinks:
- id: sink_csv
  name: Write Completed Orders
  type: CSV
  location: /data/output/completed_orders.csv
  connection:
    properties:
      path: /data/output/completed_orders.csv
      format: csv
processed_data:
- id: csv_data
  format: csv
links:
- from_id: source_csv
  to_id: filter_completed
  data_ref: csv_data
- from_id: filter_completed
  to_id: sink_csv
  data_ref: csv_data

flowContents.name: Filter Completed Orders from CSV
flowContents.comments: Read CSV files from /data/input/orders/, filter rows where status=COMPLETED, output to /data/output/completed_orders.csv
